description: Send a PDF to a US or Canadian fax number. Pass an https pdf_url. Pay with Authorization: Bearer and a prepaid API key, or with the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. priority true uses the priority price and is sent before other agent faxes. A website or app fax is still sent first. If neither payment is present the call answers 402 with both prices.

idempotency_key.description: 8 to 64 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Retries return the same fax.

priority.description: true: priority price, sent before other agent faxes. Omit for the standard price.

to.description: Fax number in the United States or Canada.

name: send_fax
